paragraphs.source_en:
The word ‘Autumn’ had not hitherto appeared in this line. Mr. Fleay pointed out to
me that it is required, for the purpose of completing, not only the full conception of
the line, but also the metre, in correspondence with the preceding stanza. I regard
this as an indisputable emendation, and introduce it accordingly, with thanks to
Mr. Fleay.
 (Rossetti 1870 ii 573)
